# Independent audit: exact endpoint budgets obstruct strictification


exact-endpoint-cap-budgets-obstruct-flat-strictification.md.
The result is an exact-preservation obstruction, not a counterexample
to budget nonincrease or to OC.

The retained endpoint margin is at least one, and every unwanted
fiber margin is at most -2. Since the finite original support is
fixed and bounded, these strict signs persist under the stated
small changes of fibers and halfspace parameters, including their
continuous normals. Thus each nearby cap budget is exactly the
volume of its designated endpoint.

The two equal budgets force endpoint volumes V. For every interior
index j, actual convexity supplies the displayed endpoint
Minkowski interpolation, and Brunn-Minkowski gives its volume at
least V. Fixed total mass mV therefore forces equality of every
interior volume and every interpolation volume. Proper inclusion
between full-dimensional compact convex bodies strictly increases
volume, so the equality of sets follows. No equality classification
for Brunn-Minkowski is needed.

For m>=3, translating only the first endpoint by epsilon v changes
the interpolated support at j=1 by
(1-1/(m-1)) epsilon u.v. Choosing u.v>0 violates the old zero support
gap. Hence no open neighborhood of independently perturbable
fibers exists. The exclusion m=2 is necessary because it has no
interior interpolation constraint.

The relative cap budget is exactly 1/m, and
m>2/Gamma_d is equivalent to its being strictly below the stated
Gamma_d/2 fraction. This does not create a small-cap cover: the
two endpoint caps leave all other fibers uncovered, as the note
explicitly states.

For inequalities alone, endpoint volumes can be smaller, so the
Brunn-Minkowski lower bound need not equal V. The proof correctly
does not extend to that case. Adding both complementary cap
constraints and holding total mass fixed forces the first two
budgets back to equality, because the nonvertical boundary has
zero mixed volume. Those added budgets are large, and the note
does not claim otherwise.

The scope is the stated finite actual fiber array (or a nearby
ambient body retaining that support), not an untracked family
with additional positive integer fibers outside the mass sum.
There is no circular depth assertion or omitted cap-boundary term.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
